description: Fetch one URL and return its main content as Markdown, e.g. to read a page found by search. Returns JSON: url, title, description, markdown, text, headings, links (first 50), lang and meta.mode_used. Content over maxChars (default 20000) is cut and the result gets truncated: true. For two or more pages use batch_extract. Pages behind logins or bot walls can fail or come back thin; try mode rendered or another source. Cloud: 1 credit for a fast fetch, 3 when the page needs a browser, +1 with region; failed and empty pages are free. Errors return isError with status and error code.

clean.description: Article-only extraction (default true). Set false for landing pages, docs indexes and dashboards, where content sits in navigation or feature blocks.

format.description: json (default) for the structured fields; markdown or text for the page content as plain text.

lang.description: Preferred page language, sent as Accept-Language, such as en or de.

maxChars.description: Max characters of page content (default 20000). Longer pages are cut and marked truncated.

minRunes.description: Minimum text length (in runes) before auto mode escalates to a browser render. 0 uses the built-in floor.

mode.description: auto (default): fast HTTP fetch, browser render if the page comes back empty. fast: HTTP only. rendered: always a browser, for JavaScript-heavy pages.

region.description: Two-letter country code to extract from, e.g. US or DE, for geo-fenced or localized pages. On Cloud this adds 1 credit per extracted URL.

url.description: Absolute URL to fetch and extract.

useLlmsTxt.description: For a site root URL, return the site's /llms-full.txt or /llms.txt instead when it has one.

name: extract
title: Extract URL
